body: observe since diffed against the last snapshot served and every act served one, so an operator who batched acts and asked for the change since the stamp read before the batch was told unknown, all ten times in the seventh trial. Now a ring of the last 8 stamps per plugin, each diffable; older is unknown and the reason names the depth; a stamp served again moves to newest; the report gets the same ring; the manifest says baselines 8 and that the report stamp is output.stamp. verify_contract 230 to 241, verify_report 249 to 252, mutate_contract 111 to 116, mutate_report 151 to 153. The eighth blind trial -- micro bench, ordination, field notebook, selection log, one attempt each, 35 of 63 outcomes and 116 of 175 claims in 311 calls -- counts non-latest since asks answered unknown at 5 of 32 against the seventh's 10 of 10; verify_tasks 429 to 446 holds both. Found and filed: the snapshot stamp is controls-only and operators read changed false as nothing happened; micro bench drops medium and organism from its zone outputs; selection log dials toggle off on re-press.
subject: ADR-230: the baseline is a ring, not a slot (protocol 1.10) -- and the eighth blind trial, four more pages nobody had driven, measures that since= the stamp before a batch is answered
